message: The other day, as I was organizing our emergency supplies, my kids thought I was setting up a treasure hunt. They were excitedly rummaging through the pantry, only to find cans of soup and flashlights instead of gold coins. I couldn't help but laugh — if only prepping for a storm was as fun as a game. But hey, at least now they know where to find the snacks when the power goes out. What’s your kids’ idea of ‘fun’ during a storm prep?
